> **Confidentiality (binding on every downstream artifact).** This document is INTERNAL. The funder is GiveDirectly; that name, "Give Directly", "GD", cash transfers and any later enrolment must never appear in anything an implementing organisation (LLO), a frontline worker (FLW), a participant or a community member sees: the solicitation, its response form, seeded responses, the work order, the Learn app, the Deliver app, training materials, the support chatbot and every outbound email (decision `llo-facing-confidentiality`). To LLOs and communities this is a digital and financial inclusion programme with an anonymous funder, and participants are told plainly that it is not a promise of future money. Sections marked **\[LLO-facing source\]** are written so their text can be lifted into LLO-facing material as is.
